name: session-start-after-own-stop-renders-the-shared-grant-line
description: Re-grounding for a file a session edited in an earlier turn (#513). Session A reads notes.md (v1), pre-edits it, commits v2 and its turn ends (session-stop), which leaves it a reader of v2. A's session-start renders the grant line for a held SHARED grant at v2, the same line fixture 01 renders for a file A only read. Before, the stop left A INVALID and the payload carried the bare 'notes.md is at v2.' line instead. No timestamps anywhere in the payload, so the whole additionalContext byte-matches across backends.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext:
Post-compaction re-grounding (agent-coherence):
At compaction you held SHARED on notes.md (v2) — re-acquire before writing.
Versions are as of this re-grounding; a more recent read supersedes this notice.
